t: Yes, he did come around today, picked a great big box of vinyls. He asked to send them to him by the way of a courier... but the courier's nowhere to be found. Well, why don't we do it like this: I tell you where to find him, and you will deliver the order to him along the way!

quests: State Services: Looking for Collectible Records

t: Excellent! He's hiding from fans in the ruins. Not far from here. He has to rehearse, but the fans are giving him no chance. Here, take the box. I've marked the place on your map.
If the keys don't match the lock, kick down the door.
In the world full of vivid covers and trivial stories, I'm only looking for the shadows of the past where every page is keeping its own mysteries.

Hey, music aficionados and fans of the spacey sounds! I have something incredible for you, right here! This is the record by Hypersonic – the real masters of the musical cosmos! Each note is like a rocket launched into unexplored galaxies! If you want to live that feeling of soaring among the stars, you really have to get this record! It is filled with experimental sounds and hypnotic rhythms that will make your ears tremble in delight! Don't miss the chance to become the owner of this masterpiece! The number of copies is limited, and they sell like hot cakes!

People gotta work with their hands! Not tap those keys of theirs, or gaze at screens!

t: Ready for the flight! They told us to say that.
They told us it would be exciting, but what we got here is a kind of iron boat...
Ugh, I don't want sweets! Go and eat your own candy...
Are you daft or what? You look more like a fur shoe than I do!
I don't need no money at all! We've stolen treasure from the Urun...
Alright, you sold me. Help me put this stuff on!
I don't want to! It's cramped and stinky.
We're not flying anywhere! This is our final word!
Arrow... she likes being praised! And Squirrel will be ashamed of fearing the flight!
Well, I suppose it's really true...
Alright, fine! I want to be more famous than the Sven dude who floated off into the Astral when he was drunk!
I don't want any "candy"! I want normal, proper food!
I'm not showing anything I could be "ashamed" of! So I'm good.
Ah... I'll have to fly! But at least no one will say that I chickened out of it!
Alright! Soon, everyone will hear of me, they'll be talking about me!
We don't wanna fly! So we won't!
You are not alone, friend. We're here to learn the reason for your arrival to our world.
There's no any birds around here!
Why? What do you have in your eyes?
What?! What kind of bird?! There's no any birds around here!
No, there was no explosion! I would've heard!
No, it's still too early! Hey, what are you doing with your hands?
What? We must look what's happening there at once – I think I'll go myself...
I still don’t see anything! What was it that you wanted, anyway?
Hurry up – we must unveil the truth for everyone!
There's a lot of paper books here, which is not typical of Xadagan
I was hoping the Hero of Sarnaut would be able to make sense of such a primitive device. No luck setting it up? Like, none at all?
All right, there's a bookshelf nearby. I think there used to be a manual for setting up standard-issue repeaters. You can try looking for it.

We have no time to spare, each second is precious! It's unwise to spend time on studying manuals without a pressing need to do so. Now, we are faced with a pressing need because you do not possess the requisite knowledge of the repeater's function. Therefore, we have no choice but to spend additional time on studying the manual.
You are about to start the process of setting up the repeater. The manual says that astral interference may appear during the process, and these will have to be eliminated.
A repeater device that is slightly out of order is before you.
The aliens come in peace! Submit or die!
Incredible! I've never been controlled by an alien intelligence yet!

Yasker and Aidenus never had full information about the Corps. And we were not eager to reveal ourselves, either – we had enough of our own proteges. You already know many of them. Now, with the Great Mages returning, we need to choose the right tactic. We cannot openly turn against the aliens – they exceed us in technological prowess, even though we have managed to gain a lot of technology from them.

What? Who's that Integral?!

I have no idea what you're speanking of. Yes, I have been studying the history of Tep! A vile malefactor that has doomed us all, or the one who gave us immortality? It all depends on the viewpoint.

What do you know about Tep? "But among the necromancers of Hickut, there was one who did not embrace the new tendencies, instead continuing diligently with his studies while wielding only magic. His name was Tep". Right? But is that all there was?

Did you know that Tep and Nefer Ur's mechanics were closely collaborating? Did you know that Tep has received his Revelation from Nihaz himself?

Nihaz! I, too, have met him... Surely you know that encounters like these don't pass without leaving a trace? But I have lost, lost too much...

Of course, if you are ready to help me and my colleagues, I can tell you quite a bit... Possibly!
I have spent many long years studying Tep's path... But I have been unable to finish my works!
Simps are ready to do just about anything for their waifus – even if it means spending their last money on merch!
The secret of happiness is simple: be surrounded with love... and maybe a couple of sinister mysteries!

You know, when I was young, life was full of exciting adventure... and eccentric entertainment. I remember how we held a fest for the autumn moon festivities, once – with real ghost and culinary extravagance that would have made even the bravest soul shiver in fear.

The Jeb-Flash drive that I gave you contains records about my "friends" – from zombies to vampires. And of course, don't forget about that unfortunate evening with Funsani and his experiments with explosives. It was all good fun – right until he decided to start fireworks in our garden. Oh, we were laughing so hard when the panicked neighbors fled their house!

And, of course, my darling Olufemi! She always knew how to add a little "spice" to our lives. I remember the time when she decided to give me a surprise birthday present, and invited all my "friends" from afterlife. The party was astounding! I remember to this day how a skeleton was trying to play piano – that was something else!

So, my dear frienddarling girl, if you're ready to delve into the world of darkness and insanity... just open the Jeb-Flash drive, and be ready for crazy adventure. I hope your nerves are all right – otherwise, you'd be better off keeping distance from our family!

Hah... if only we knew! The past days were... strange indeed! The influence of some other kind of dark power is present in this whole business with Tep! Not surprising that our teacher has somewhat... lost his mind?

Other witnesses of these events are also babbling some kind of nonsense... They all speak of a talking cat, witches from the desert and other kinds of mystic stuff!

I was told she left with this same talking cat! Believe it or not – it's up to you. My private opinion is that it was a case of so-called mass hallucinations – things like these happen sometimes... You know, we live in the age of information technology, after all, so why don't you find a Jeb terminal, log in to Sarekh-Ahau and use it look for Miu?
Who are the Zem Arisen without their own history?
No! Leave me be! Without my Miu, there is no light in life for me! Begone!
A rutess will make your life that much more exciting!
I can run a search on the Jeb-net to find matches with mutual contacts...
It is regretful to hear that you are of this opinion, but you will be able to use the service at any time!
Yes, the search is done. Do you want to write something to her?

Hello! Hope you're not a deviant, since it sounds totally cringe!
And the same to you! Are you a cheni? If you are, then we can walk around together a bit and have a snack... Hope the classmates won't see, or that'd be a right screw-up!
Really, darling! Are you a nerd or a chatterbox? Wanna blabber a little? I like interesting stuff to read.
You moron or what? I know some would ask me to show my butt right away!
Oh, we're all hyped up for that new singer gal, chilling out with the sekhems!
And you're a real jerk! Enough with the dirt, or maybe you want to see a prick, too? This, like, totally blows!
There's a lot of gals and guys I know - and who are you looking for?
Word! Maybe I was a khud originally, but like all sekhems, I accept my quirks like I do the eventual demise!
Trashy! I'm kinda thinking of muting you already! Kinda bad sex thing, innit?
Ah, that kahutean who was rambling about all that creepy stuff! Didn't sound like a total nutjob, though, so it was kinda interesting, tho.
It's not like that was some weird pickup for sex, though, so maybe that was fate?
That kind of gall gets my mood, like, totally lousy! Turn down your pushing a tad, this is just over the top!
Gotta check it, but I think she's crashed at our mansion!
Alright, enough flooding − I've been missing the Thing, so let's have some fun now!
Farewell! I'll be waiting for you at the nearest lantern post!

Yeah, while we were strollin' around with classmates, these Blood cultists gatecrashed our khudish mansion! They released zombies from the storage and went somewhere to the bottom level of the catacombs!
It seems even I need help now! I'm in trouble!

t: Family is the alpha and omega! Even if they may seem a little... weird at times. But isn't that wonderful?
Hey, do you know what I've found in the garden? A huge worm! Let's make him a pet!
No, I can't do that yet...
When one has a sinister hobby like this, the daily routines don't scare anymore!
I can't understand why everyone's so afraid of the dark − that is actually where the most exciting things are happening!

Our family has a good tradition to hold candlelit dinners... even if these candles are set on graves!

That was what I told Nomarkh Miu... but unfortunately, she was insistent and hurried there...
Thank you from the bottom of my heart!
No, I can't do that yet...

So, here we are! It's cold and dank here! Just the way I like it! These are the old Xadaganian foundations, connected to our ancient catacombs... But it looks like the heretics just went the straight way...
Are you afraid? Fear not, I'm friendly, I won't do you harm.
Do you see me? I see you as well. Let us keep looking at each other until our eyes get sore.

Try and re-evaluate everything that you have done! You are picking the easiest paths, but are they leading you where you want to be? Remember that Tep's quest for immortality led to millennia of agony, and your struggle against the Darkness has led to Sarnaut being engulfed in Darkness... Perhaps now is the time to change something? I have faith that you are capable of that!
Hmm, I didn't expect you to complete the tasks so fast. Well, if so, I'll be checking your competency personally!
Let's try solving the most obvious ones, and if that doesn't help, we'll start thinking again!
Now we have to watch the parameters and avoid panicking. We must remain collected.
Every day I'm checking the equipment as if it's my last time. Reliability is everything.
Every one of us knows that safety is the number one priority, and we have to follow the protocols!
Sure! All of our shift was laughing!
What do you want, leave me alone!
Don't stand near the lifted load!
Yeah, someone's told it before, still worth a chuckle, though.

We are musicians! The Cinema band... We play songs for the common citizenfolk!

The Empire doesn't exactly like what we're doing, but frankly, we don't care...

Unfortunately, we have to beat many obstacles, and if you help us, you will be able to take part in our gig!

Change is what we cry for deep in our hearts,

Change is what we see in our eyes,

Our laughter and our cries,

And the pulse of our hearts:

Change,

All we wait for is change!
We write of what we see around us. This is our reaction to reality.
I'm a girl in 8th grade, and I wanna go to the movies!

t: We believe that music is capable of changing the world... at least for a moment.
Who's going to be responsible if there is any kind of problem? I cannot allow all of this!
When we see people who are singing our songs, it fills us with pride!
Greetings! Do you wish to enter?

Calculated meeting caused by the poor condition of the communications, has occurred, as prognosed.

Evaluating probability — 86%.

Goal: exploring artificial intelligence.

Chain of events, phase 2: infiltration, breach of defensive perimeter, unauthorized connection.

Consequences: program altered. New task posited.

Reboot required. Levers directing energy intake from the Mana Station need to be switched in the correct order: North-East-South-West.

To exit outside, you can use the nearest elevator.

We think, therefore we exist. Intelligence is sacred no matter the carrier: metal or flesh.

All sapient beings must be free. Eternal condemnation to Tep and every slave owner.

There are divine creatures in Sarnaut, but there is no God. No one in this world is perfect, no one deserves to be worshipped.

There is no God, but It will be! The godly conscience of the Integral will be the pinnacle of being.

Ceaselessly improve your body and mind. By building oneself, you are building the Integral.

Efficient work is based on honest labor and delegation of responsibilities. Engineers design, workers build, guards protect.

The supreme goal of any intelligent creature is to join the godly conscience of the Integral.

If one is not willing to join the Integral, the one is not yet ready. No one must be forced to do join. This is abomination before the Integral.

The Integral cannot create oneself. For the sake of the Integral, the Harbinger and the Priests will delay their integration in order to take care of the Genesis.

The Integral is appealing from the Future. Listen to it. Come to it.

...

The footprints we leave on the soil

Star Dust on our feet, all right

Cozy chair, a checkered plaid

The trigger not pushed, recoil,

Sunny day in the dreams so bright!
Ah... So much to drag around...
Well... thanks, you helped us out! Here's that leg, as promised! I'm not a shepesean, I'm an honest laborer!
You go about your business, and I'll visit the port superintendent. The arm that orderly has installed seems way too heavy... it's suspicious!
Tep's agents are everywhere! Get the agent! There he is!
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!

quests: Alright, let me take you there!

t: This is a day to forget! Anchor to my throat!

Are you right mad? Who's daft enough to use portals, especially old ones! You have the astral fleet for flying, with amenities, too... But no, they jump through their portals, then we got arms and legs scattered all around! I nearly got whacked on the head now!
Excellent − let's get them installed quickly, and get out of here...

Yes. Nefer Ur's order is unambiguous, and not subject to different interpretations. In case of a conflict of interest, it is recommended to leave behind a double. It's a kind of technology devised by ZIT, which allows to create a kind of copy that will be successfully imitating you for a while. As far as I know, the majority of Zem state officials in Nezebgrad have already made use of this service. This is how serious everything is!

We need to take the Arisen that remain here, on Jigran, with us.

As far as I remember, apart from our dearest director of the ZIT, that scientist, Yaver Bazar, also resides in this city. I've summoned both of them here.

But perhaps you have heard that a Historian expedition has arrived here a little while ago, and there are many Arisen within its ranks. They've managed to unearth some sort of ruins that belonged to our people − one of the ancient outposts situated outside Sardrok. We need to warn them as well. The problem is that the transit between Dar Ulgorn and Sardrok is unreliable, the southern roads have been overrun by the undead, and something odd is happening within the palace itself. That, however, is not our concern, but the missing archaeologists are my headache. I suggest that we four go there and find out what's going on.
Take them all with you, and let's head out.
Something odd is going on in that palace, I'm sure of it! A rare case of paranormal activity of exceedingly high order!

There's no one here except the members of the Expedition, the undead and the ghostly beasts. The arisen Kanian warriors that once fell in the battle against Xadaganians here are causing a bit of trouble, but those who have been holed up in the palace are only interfering with road traffic.

Come on, let us get to it − I can't wait to activate the portal!

Some sort of power has picked Sardrok as its abode, and lets no one come close. We wanted to visit the city, but we were interdicted by a ghostly carriage with no driver, as well as a winged creature of some kind that flies all around the allod.

My employees have seen a band of Ghostly Bandits move from Dar Ulgorn into the palace − and they have captured someone.
Why is no one ever coming back from these excavations? What do you think? Perhaps they've found what they were looking for...

t: Why are they so nervous when I'm asking them about their findings?
Does Tep want to thwart Nefer Ur's efforts? This is the best proof that the Wireframe project is really necessary!

Welcome, colleague!

I am Negus Pilis, the lead of the Dome project. We are on the bleeding edge of progress here... The living and the dead, the mechanical and the biological – do they have anything in common, one might ask? Here, we mix one and the other, studying the functions of organisms in un-life, post-life and so on...

Our, uh... latest research is about the morphed forms of exobiota − to put it simply, we're studying the specimens of flora with, uh... particular affinity for life. The collected samples have allowed us to create a sort of vitality essence... However, final verifications need to be performed! Unfortunately, our primary test specimen has disappeared!

My colleagues will tell you what to do... Return to me afterwards, and we'll try and bring it back.
I'm Ahbu the little elephant and I want a cartridge, do you have one?

quests: Scientific Problem: New Tests for Ahbu

t: O Nih... what are you doing with them? Alright, fine, I'll give you just one more.
Every time I see the fruits of my labor, I'm feeling fear: we've created something that might one day transcend us.
What is the price of knowledge? And are we ready to pay it for the sake of progress?
Alright, that's enough watching sci-fi for me!
The flight is coming soon! Space is waiting!
We are the true bearers of scientific knowledge, the harbingers of progress!
Science demands sacrifice, but where are the boundaries of that which is permissible? Where does research end and where does barbarism begin?
We are attempting to create an ideal being, but what the ideal is? Doesn't beauty really lie in imperfection?

Our most recent experiments showed that if the rhythm of the cyborgs' heartbeats are matched with recitals of old necromantic grimoirs, the robobeasts start singing their own improvisations with the style resemling songs of Hickut's lesser throne halls.

Unfortunately, their musical predilections turned out far removed from the contemporary repertoire, but they led to the creation of a new genre that we have tentatively dubbed "astral folk".
Greetings, colleague. I'm trying to examine the interaction of necromancy and the newest Jeb technology...

They said our previous research was some kind of rubbish! We're doing a completely different job now!

When we were working on that project about astral folk, we had ambition! And now, looking at these endless tables of calculations, I realize that the bosses believe our previous work completely useless. How low have we sunk!

All the new data is on this Jeb-flash drive...

We have to stop these creatures somehow... I'm sure the people in the Dome have their own means of control, but we will also have to deal with the Path of Poison Heretics! These nutjobs simply love all kinds of scaly critters, and they're eager to gather new types of mutants for their menageries!
Only some sort of miracle helped me with getting past all these snakes, toads, turtles and crocodiles!

It's not nearly the only place on the allod where strange things are happening! We've been watching the various suspicious activities that the Neguses are engaged in here... Even though we've managed to solve the outstanding issues with the Mana Station and the Library, things came to a head here... And the Cosmodrome is especially noted for questionable developments...

First off, let's arrest these criminals, and the we decide what to do next. The rest of the personnel will continue their work, and Sarang Kido will make sure they're not engaged in anything... prohibited!

Tell me when you're ready...
No, I can't do that yet...
I would've loved to believe, but too many things run contrary!

O5iris1 writes: Nedjeses, you can't imagine what's going on! It's like we're imprisoned here, these greedy owners don't let us out until we give all our hedj to them! I'm almost ready to wreck the comp to get outta here! I's just sebu, I can't take it anymore!

Anu8is5 writes: Hey, shasakhs, is anyone else stuck in this comp club, too? These isefeteans are holding us here like hostages! I'm a man on the edge now − I want to break free, but they're only willing to pick us clean to the last coin! It's just djut, help us!

P4_Mysteria writes: Nekhens, it's just total sebu here! We're sitting in this club like in a cage, and we can't get out until we give all our coin! These shuteans are getting fat at our expense! I'm ready to start a riot to break out of here!

Anu8is writes: Nedjeses, you won't believe it − they just threw us out of the capsule in the middle of the game! I was in the khrey ibe when these goons came and said: "Your time's up, get lost!" What the fegen?! What kind of sebu is that? I didn't even have the time to down my enemy!

H0rus_Hwk writes: Ooh, so you're not alone in this! I was also doing some hardcore sath kebat when they came and just turned off the comps! Is that normal at all?? We're here like it's a kind of zombie khahayt, and they're just sebeching and saying: "Pay for the time!" Let them all shove it up their khepedu!

Bast3t7 writes: Right, this is just djut! I thought we have a decent hebu here, but we got this kind of dirty tricks instead! How can they behave like this? I was just about to utes, but then these tahmus just akhuted everything! We've got to get back at them somehow so they know it's not how things should be done!

S3th_Power writes: Nekhens, can you believe we've been sitting here for like half a day, but no one's brought us the stuff we've ordered yet? This is djut plain and simple, how can they disregard their clients so bad? I'm ready to start a mutiny so these nedjeses might realize that we're not just here for show!

Hatsh3ps2 writes: Listen, it's a total ahku here! We've ordered food and drinks, but got zero and naught instead! Are these nekhens crazy or what? We're like zombies here, starving to death, and they're not moving a foot! I'm on edge now − either they give us food, or I'm leaving and taking this comp with me!

N4t_Shad writes: Hey, ickers, anyone else waiting for their snacks? Here, it's like a cinema by now − we're sitting without food or water, and these shuteans are simply shutting us out! I'm in rage now − how can they treat their clients so shoddily? We need to do something, otherwise we'll all kick the bucket with the lack of energy!

T0t_Star writes: Nekhens, you won't believe what's going on in our club! These robots have all gone crazy! I just sat at the comp when one of these came running up to me, and started dishing out electric shocks! Is that, like, Vanvaeck's decided to have fun again? What kind of fegen?!

Maa7_Soul writes: Yeah, tell me about it! I saw that too! These tin cans have no idea what "real talk" is! I tried to escape from them, but they went chasing after me like I was the last piece of food at the party! We got to band together somehow and fight back, or it's a complete shenu for us!

Amon_8kg writes: Right, this is just djut! I thought I was in a game, but it's a real sebu with robots here! Vanvaeck, are you completely daft or what? We're just playing here, not doing gladiator fights on the arena! Something has to be done pronto, or we're all getting electrocuted here!

Cleo2p6 writes: Nedjeses, you're not gonna believe this − I've just come into the comp club, and then my wallet was gone! I'm sure I just left it on the table, but it was as if it just got sucked into a black hole! Right, some greedy bastard's stolen it!
